title: Elf Bar Plus50 Mango Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Mango from the Elf Bar Plus50 pod range captures the smooth sweetness of ripe Mango with its naturally rich and juicy character. A rounded tropical vape with a clean finish, this flavour offers a deeply satisfying draw that’s mellow yet full-flavoured. Each Plus50 pod is prefilled with 2ml of 20mg Nic Salt and connects easily to the Elf Bar Plus50 Kit. The additional 10ml refill tank lets you top up the pod multiple times, offering up to 5,500 puffs in total. Mesh coil technology ensures consistently smooth flavour and a refined MTL (mouth-to-lung) inhale.
